intro: Thunder Lizard Blood is a vital fluid taken from the massive thunder lizards wandering the southern Barrens. It serves as martial proof of survival against some of Kalimdor's most crushing terrestrial beasts.

p: Thunder lizards, known across the plains as Stormsnouts, Stormhides, and Thunderheads, are colossal beasts whose heavy strides shake the earth. Hunting them is an exercise in perilous footing, as their crushing weight easily flattens unwary stalkers. Bringing back their blood demonstrates not just hunting prowess, but the sheer endurance needed to survive a bout beneath their thundering feet.
